group_position: last shot of grp012 — Alice reaches her map end (corner). The White Rabbit reaches his map end (hall_opening) off-frame and is gone.

characters.label: Alice
characters.start_pos: rounding the right-angle corner at a run and pulling up short on it
characters.space_fragment_en: standing at the right-angle corner on screen-left, pulled up short, facing the opening into the long hall on screen-right
characters.facing: round the corner and past the lens toward the hall lamplight; the open screen-right of frame is where her look is going

path.to: stopped on the corner itself, both feet planted

beats.action: comes round the corner close behind him

beats.sync: he is gone and the hall is there instead

beats.action: her look goes on past the lens into the opening hall

performance_beat.objective: catch sight of him again before the corner costs her the chase
performance_beat.emotional_arc: from full pursuit to a stopped, wide-open astonishment at the room in front of her

trigger.beat: she plants both feet and the run stops

performance_beat.end_state: stopped on the corner, weight still forward, eyes past the lens into the lamplight, lips apart

offscreen_presence.where: through the opening into the long hall, already out of sight
offscreen_presence.note: grp012 map end. He is lost here and does not reappear until grp028.

presence_check.story_event: ev0003 (dream) — 'she lost the Rabbit around a corner'
presence_check.note: The Rabbit must be out of frame here; S05 is composed so that his absence from the hall is provable.
